confirm_deposit.description: Verify the depositor name and amount, then record the deposit.

confirm_deposit.mark_order_complete_hint: When checked, the order status is changed to paid along with recording the deposit (including mileage earning, stock deduction, and notifications). When unchecked, only the deposit is recorded.
confirm_deposit.past_payment_hint: This order is already at {{status}}, so only the deposit and the paid amount are recorded and the order status is left unchanged.

cancel.title: Cancel Order
cancel.description: Cancelling does not refund immediately. A refund request is created and the cancellation is confirmed only after approval and refund completion.
cancel.pg_error_description: PG refund processing failed. Please check the error details and try again, or process the refund directly through the PG admin dashboard.
cancel.auto_advance_refund_label: Process the refund in one step
cancel.auto_advance_refund_hint: When checked, the refund request is created and advanced through approval and completion automatically. Refunds that require a bank transfer stop at the request stage; an operator approves them, sends the money and completes them with [Refund].
cancel.auto_advance_refund_no_permission: You cannot turn this on without the refund execution permission. An administrator with that permission completes the refund request from the claim detail.
cancel.auto_advance_refund_blocked_hint: This order's payment method needs a person to transfer the money, so the request stops at the requested state even if you check this. Approve it and then complete the transfer with [Refund].
cancel.refund_priority_no_points_hint: No mileage was used, so refund priority cannot be selected.
cancel.restored_coupons_notice: Above coupons will be restored to your coupon box.
cancel.refund_request_created: A refund request has been filed. The cancellation is confirmed once it is approved and the refund completes.
cancel.refund_request_created_no_claim_access: Refund request {{number}} has been filed. An operator with claim permission must approve it and complete the refund to confirm the cancellation.
cancel.refund_request_auto_stopped: The refund request was submitted, but automatic processing stopped because this payment method cannot be refunded automatically. Approve the request and complete it with [Refund] to confirm the cancellation.
cancel.refund_bank_required_hint: A refund account is required for a paid virtual account order.
cancel.refund_bank_empty_hint: No banks are registered for refund accounts. Register them first under Settings > Order settings > Manage banks.
cancel.refund_bank_partial_notice: If you fill in any one of the three fields, the others are required.
cancel.partial_unsupported: This payment method supports full cancellation only. Cancelling part of the items or quantities will be rejected by the payment gateway.
cancel.partial_unsupported_vbank_awaiting: Orders awaiting a virtual account deposit can only be cancelled in full. The issued account amount cannot be changed, so a partial cancellation would leave the customer's deposit unconfirmed.

vbank_close_failed.warning: This order was cancelled before deposit, but the virtual account could not be closed at the payment provider. Close it in the provider's admin console so the customer cannot deposit.

tax_invoice.needs_review: This order has cancellations, but an issued tax invoice remains. Tax invoice cancellation or re-issuance is not automated — handle it directly with the tax authority.

claim_request.no_permission: You do not have permission to file exchanges, returns or cancellations.
claim_request.context_load_failed: Could not load whether claims can be filed. Please refresh.
claim_request.editor_label: Exchange / return on behalf of customer dialog
claim_request.description: Filed on behalf of the customer. The request period and requestable-status settings do not apply.
claim_request.charge_method_auto: Auto (choose if there is a charge)
claim_request.preview_needs_reason: Select a reason to calculate the fee and charge.
claim_request.approve_no_permission: You lack the claim status change permission, so this files the request only. An administrator with that permission approves it from the claim detail.
claim_request.customer_notice: The customer is notified that the seller filed on their behalf, and cannot withdraw or edit this request.

manual_paid.title: Payment processing items
manual_paid.description: {{count}} of the selected orders are unpaid or cancelled. Choose what to apply with this change.
manual_paid.description_single: This order is unpaid or cancelled. Choose what to apply with this change.
manual_paid.preview_error: Could not load the payment processing items. Close and try again.
manual_paid.stock_hint: Reduces product stock by the ordered quantity.
manual_paid.stock_off_warning: If stock is not deducted now, cancelling this order later will not return stock.
manual_paid.mileage_hint: Deducts the mileage used on this order from the member's balance. When reviving a cancelled order, mileage returned at cancellation is deducted again.
manual_paid.mileage_short_warning: Not enough balance — these orders would block the change: {{order_numbers}}
manual_paid.mileage_short_warning_single: The member's mileage balance ({{balance}}) is too low, so the change will be refused. Turn off the deduction to proceed.
manual_paid.mileage_off_warning: If mileage is not deducted, no mileage will be returned on a later refund.
manual_paid.record_hint: Records the amount due as received. Keep this on only if you confirmed the approval in the PG console. The PG transaction ID is not recorded.
manual_paid.record_off_warning: If not recorded, the paid amount stays at 0, so nothing can be refunded in cash on a later cancellation or return.
manual_paid.auto_sync_note: For {{count}} orders with a recorded deposit, the paid amount is set from that deposit.
manual_paid.auto_sync_note_one: For {{count}} order with a recorded deposit, the paid amount is set from that deposit.
manual_paid.auto_sync_note_single: The paid amount will be set to the recorded deposit of {{amount}}.
manual_paid.never_paid_note: For {{count}} cancelled orders without a payment record, keeping "Record payment amount" on records the revived order total as received. If off, it remains as an amount due.
manual_paid.never_paid_note_one: For {{count}} cancelled order without a payment record, keeping "Record payment amount" on records the revived order total as received. If off, it remains as an amount due.
manual_paid.never_paid_note_single: This order was cancelled without a payment record. Keeping "Record payment amount" on records the revived total as received; if off, it remains as an amount due.
manual_paid.restoration_label: Revive cancelled items and recalculate order totals ({{count}} orders, {{quantity}} items)
manual_paid.restoration_label_one: Revive cancelled items and recalculate order totals ({{count}} order, {{quantity}} items)
manual_paid.restoration_label_single: Revives {{quantity}} cancelled items and recalculates the order total from {{before}} to {{after}}
manual_paid.restoration_hint: Restores the order amount, shipping, discounts and coupon usage that cancellation set to 0, using the original order terms. Cancellation and refund records are kept.
manual_paid.restoration_hint_partial: Recalculates the order amount, shipping and discounts including the revived items. Cancellation and refund records are kept.
manual_paid.restoration_coupon_conflict: These orders cannot be revived because their coupon was already used by another order: {{order_numbers}}
manual_paid.restoration_coupon_conflict_single: This order cannot be revived because its coupon ({{coupons}}) was already used by another order.
manual_paid.restoration_legacy_snapshot: For {{count}} orders the original coupon details are missing, so totals are recalculated with the current coupon details and may differ from the original.
manual_paid.restoration_legacy_snapshot_one: For {{count}} order the original coupon details are missing, so totals are recalculated with the current coupon details and may differ from the original.
manual_paid.restoration_legacy_snapshot_single: The original coupon details are missing, so the total is recalculated with the current coupon details and may differ from the original.

warning.pg_already_cancelled: The card or other PG payment of this order has already been cancelled. Later refunds must be made by bank transfer or mileage.
warning.pg_already_cancelled_orders: The card or other PG payment has already been cancelled for these orders ({{order_numbers}}). Later refunds must be made by bank transfer or mileage.
